2 days Taj Mahal and Jaipur tour by car

Delhi · Agra · Jaipur · 2 days

2 days Jaipur tour packages Private tour Licensed guide

Agra on day one, Jaipur on day two, one night in between — the two big destinations without the Delhi sightseeing day.

At a glance

Duration

Destinations

Pickup
Hotel or airport in Delhi NCR

What makes this one worth it

  • Taj Mahal and Agra Fort with a licensed guide
  • Fatehpur Sikri on the drive between the two cities
  • Amber Fort and the Jaipur city palaces
  • Only one hotel change in two days

Your day by day

  1. Day 1

    Agra, the Taj Mahal and on to Jaipur

    Early pickup in Delhi, drive to Agra. Taj Mahal and Agra Fort with your guide, then on to Jaipur via Fatehpur Sikri. Overnight in Jaipur.

  2. Day 2

    Amber Fort, the Jaipur palaces and back to Delhi

    Amber Fort at opening, Jal Mahal, City Palace, Jantar Mantar and Hawa Mahal, then the drive back to Delhi.

What the price covers

  • Private AC car for both days
  • Licensed guides in Agra and Jaipur
  • One night hotel with breakfast
  • All monument tickets
  • Tolls, parking and taxes

What it does not cover

  • Lunch and dinner
  • Camera fees
  • Tips
  • Anything not listed under inclusions

Questions people ask

Why skip Delhi?
Many travellers have already seen Delhi or are flying in and out of it. This route spends the time on Agra and Jaipur instead.
Which city should we stay in?
Jaipur, usually. It makes day two start at the fort rather than in the car.
